jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp)
jobs.description:
Overview

The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.

This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.

Responsibilities

Influence product strategy: Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention.
Set the analytics vision: Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue.
Lead experimentation and causal measurement: Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible.
Size and prioritize opportunities: Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment.
Uncover growth opportunities: Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades.
Shape the AI-native roadmap: Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems.
Raise the scientific bar: Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality.
Lead and mentor: Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.

Qualifications

8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact.
Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus.
Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R.
Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making.
Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis.
Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems.
Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI.
Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start.
Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists.
Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.

Design realistic finance tasks based on your day-to-day work, including the scenario, a prompt written the way you would brief a trusted colleague, and supporting files you author yourself (financial statements, models, data extracts, term sheets, board or IC materials, correspondence).
Run tasks through frontier AI models and evaluate the resulting deliverables against the standard you would hold a colleague to.

Ability to turn real-world experience into realistic test scenarios.

Familiarity with AI tools and the judgment to spot a plausible but incorrect answer.
Comfortable with cloud file tools (e.g., Google Workspace), installing desktop apps, and everyday file handling.
Available at least 10 hours per week and based in the United States, Canada, or the United Kingdom.

Compensation for every completed stage of work

What You Will Be Doing

Research Assistant I

Leon Root Motion Analysis Laboratory (LRMALab)

Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS)

Requirements of this position include a Bachelors degree (BS or BA) in engineering, rehabilitation, biology, physical therapy, kinesiology, anatomy, physiology, neuroscience, or a related discipline; interest and basic experience in the motion analysis process; and excellent written and verbal communication skills. The ideal candidate would have experience in human movement analysis but new graduates will be considered. Prior clinical experience would be a plus.

The Research Assistant I
position includes collection and analysis of 3D and 2D motion capture, ground reaction force, electromyographic, and plantar pressure data on patients to serve as the basis for their clinical treatment planning.

This Research Assistant I
is a one-year full-time position which may be extended based upon both positive performance review and programmatic need. Benefits are included.

The Position Responsibilities Are Primarily But Not Limited To

Perform data collection and processing for individuals undergoing clinical movement analysis or research protocols.
Preparation and calibration of instrumentation for data collection and maintenance of laboratory space and equipment
Manage research subject recruitment and related documentation. This includes: contacting and screening subjects, test scheduling, providing informed consent, and updating and maintaining research study documents.
Assist with the preparation and submission of grants.
Communication with physicians, scientists, physical therapists, biomechanists, and administrative staff.

The person is expected to work closely with LRMALab and HSS staff to creatively streamline study workflows and increase efficiency by identifying roadblocks, brainstorming alternative strategies, and scheduling meetings to appraise study progress. You will receive guidance and training from a number of other faculty and staff in the clinical and scientific aspects of human movement analysis. You will report to Silvia Zanini, MS our Biomechanist III.

The LRMALab evaluates a wide range of individuals including pediatric, adult and geriatric in a multi-disciplinary environment. There are typically 10 to 20 active research studies. There are typically a full case load of lower extremity and upper extremity movement analysis patients. Our central philosophy is to objectively examine anatomical/physiological structure and biomechanical function to improve our methods of treating neuromusculoskeletal disease. Our vision is to enhance diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment strategies.
